# Vendored cello-kit packages

Copied from github.com/celloopa/cello-kit at tag `v0.9.0` (commit `fa9ebd8465ea51575184b9ff87c3de04742e7b13`) by `scripts/vendor-cello-kit.sh`.
Do not edit these files here. Change cello-kit, tag it, then re-run the script with the new tag.
They are vendored because cello-kit is private and Netlify builds the site without GitHub credentials.
